name: Universal

rows.label: Total Liabilities
rows.derivedFormula: Total Liabilities = Total Assets - Total Equity

note: Balance sheet checked against the accounting identity (assets = liabilities + equity). Rows computed from the period's own component rows or from the other two totals are marked derived; figures that could not be reconciled are withheld and listed in _balance_identity_withheld.json.
rowSourceNote: Current/Non-current Liabilities and Cash & Equivalents read from the same filing page whose Total Liabilities reproduces the stored row; Capital Expenditure from the page whose Operating Cash Flow does.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
